name: CREA Summer Camp
description_short: Nature day camp from the Brunswick-Topsham Land Trust at the Cathance River Nature Preserve. Nature Explorers (entering grades 1 to 5) and Trailblazers (grades 6 to 8) hike the preserve's trails, search the river and ponds for frogs and newts, build boats and make art from natural materials, Monday to Friday 8:30 to 4.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds once registered. Cancelling before May 1 earns a credit for the next year's camp.
notes: Places are given by lottery: the 2027 lottery is open January 25 to February 2, 2027 ($10 per family), slots are allocated February 3 to 9 and registration is due March 1, 2027. Campers may attend one week per summer.
